description: Roll out a security configuration change (enable audit logging, harden SSH config, set kernel sysctl params) to 10,000 Linux hosts across a global fleet using a configuration management tool. The rollout must follow staged rings: validate config in a canary of 100 hosts (ring 0, 1%), then 500 hosts (ring 1, 5%), then 2500 hosts (ring 2, 25%), then the full fleet (ring 3, 100%). Each ring must include: config validation (syntax check, dry-run), health verification (host is reachable, key services running, no SSH lockout), and a fast rollback path (revert config and re-apply within 5 minutes). Risk factors: SSH hardening can lock out administrators, sysctl changes can affect networking, and fleet scale means a bad config affects thousands of hosts. Tools available: Ansible, Puppet, Salt, SSH, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana), config validation (ansible-playbook --check, puppet parser validate).
